name: VIN Cube 3x3 Racer (Magnetic, Ball-Core, UV Coated)
description: The VIN Cube 3x3 Racer (Magnetic, Ball-Core, UV Coated) is a premium magnetic speed cube built for cubers who want a fast, responsive feel with more control built into the core. Standard magnets help pieces click into place more accurately, Ball-Core technology adds stability and omnidirectional positioning, and the CFRS adjustment system gives you a wide range of setup options. With a compact 55.
features: Fast but controlled feel: Magnetic turning and Ball-Core stability work together to keep the cube quick without feeling loose.
More confident alignment: 35-degree auto-alignment helps the cube finish turns more cleanly.
Customizable setup: The CFRS system gives you a wide range of feel options, from crisp and light to tighter and more stable.
Secure grip: UV coating adds anti-slip grip while also resisting scratches.
Lightweight handling: The 72g build and 55.5mm size keep the cube agile and easy to control.
CFRS adjustment system: Centrifugal force regulation lets you switch between crisp, snappy, and stable turning styles.
